ModMetaData.name: RimSynapse - Conversations
ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.7.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Conversations Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Conversations/wiki
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Allows colonists to converse dynamically using LLMs.
--- Roadmap --- 0.6 - Agent and Tool Foundation: Delivered in v0.6.0 - the colonist conversation layer on top of Core's agent loop. 0.7 - Regions and Territories Compatibility: Current release - carried forward under the shared infrastructure. 0.8 - Demographics, News and Narrative Voice: An expanded agent toolset - chat-history and colonist-interest retrieval, and universe and world actions the storyteller can take in-world. 0.9 - Factions and Living Societies: Auto-running therapy sessions land with Psychology, and conversations react to faction and social events. 0.10 - Cross-Mod Capability Passes: Another pass over how dialogue ties psychology, factions and news together. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog --- v0.7.0 - Regions and Territories Compatibility - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.7.0. - Requires Core v0.7.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged. v0.6.1 - Fixed: the in-game mod list showed v0.5.2 with no 0.6.0 notes; version and changelog now agree everywhere - Roadmap updated: 0.7 is Regions and Territories compatibility (groundwork for Factions, which will require Empire) v0.6.0 - Moves in step with RimSynapse Core v0.6.0 (Agent and Tool Foundation) - Requires Core v0.6.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged - In-game wiki guides updated; "MCP" renamed to game tools throughout v0.5.2 - Maintenance release, aligned with Core and Psychology fixes - Licence changed to PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 v0.4.0 - Updated to support RimSynapse Core v0.4.0 (Multi-provider routing and Image generation).
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables noble tone demands and psycast interjections. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables faith debates and active proselytizing. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables xenotype dialects and mechanitor comms. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables paranoid void whispers. - RimSynapse - Psychology: Compatible and Optional. Colonists will naturally bring up their deep core memories, traumas, and trust levels during everyday conversations.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
